Before you choose

A few clear answers.

What is The Proximity Edit?

A collection of practical reports for business owners, entrepreneurs, creators, and people exploring new ventures. Each edition connects a subject to questions, examples, and tools for working through a decision.

What is included with a report?

Each current edition includes a PDF and editable Word document. The beauty edition includes an Excel workbook. Farming, business relationships, and content creation include interactive browser editions. Open a report preview for its exact package.

How much do the reports cost?

The Beauty Services, Soil-First Farming, and Business Relationships editions are $57 USD each. The Content Creation edition is $59 USD. These are individual digital products, not a subscription. Review final checkout terms and any applicable taxes before purchasing.

Are the 2027 reports records of completed 2027 results?

No. They are forward-looking planning editions prepared in October 2026. Published guidance, editorial interpretations, and illustrative examples are distinguished. They do not claim knowledge of completed 2027 outcomes.

Is the report finder a business assessment?

No. It matches your selected subject to a report and adapts the suggested starting point to your other choices. It does not evaluate your business, assign a validated score, or predict success.

Do the reports guarantee income or results?

No. They help organize research, choices, and implementation. Illustrative models are not typical earnings or local market prices. Outcomes depend on your circumstances, costs, qualifications, market, and execution.

Where are my shortlist and reflection saved?

Your shortlist stays in this page’s memory unless you explicitly save it on your device. Saved shortlists and notes use this browser’s local storage, not a publisher account. They may not persist in private sessions or across devices. You can erase the local copy or download a note backup.

How do I purchase and download my report package?

Choose a report and continue to its SendOwl checkout. Review the product, price, payment methods, purchase terms, and any applicable taxes there. After a successful purchase, use the order-specific download instructions from SendOwl. The full paid files are not linked publicly on this website.
